Please note, beach access when you stay with your family at Wanderawhile30A is very important.

REST ASSURED, there is open/easy beach access to 3 beach areas from Wanderawhile30A all accessible via the community Beach Tram.

One is deeded private and two are public. The crowds will vary from the time of year and time of the day. You can decide which beach fits your family best.

Wanderawhile30A is located in the TreeTop gated community of Seacrest Beach within walking distance of Rosemary, Inlet, and Alys Beaches!

Over 100 "10" star reviews will assure you this is the perfect home for your next family beach vacation.

Fresh paint, new furniture, new bikes, updated master bathroom in late 2024 all for you and your family.

Enjoy the comfort and quiet of this newly built single family residential home in the private Gated Community of Treetop located in Seacrest Beach, and is a short walk to the Seacrest private deeded beach access and less than 1 minute to the private community pool.

The TreeTop community at Seacrest Beach is one of only a handful along scenic 30A with direct access to BOTH Hwy 98 and 30A - thus, during high season, guest have the option of avoiding the endless summer traffic on 30A making trips to the nearby new Publix, or other beaches in high traffic times.

Enjoy bicycling or walking to and from Seacrest Village, Rosemary Beach, Inlet Beach and Alys Beach, all within a short distance of the property! Or relax and enjoy a cup of tea or a glass of wine on your very own secluded screened in porch or the newly added front porch.

Wanderawhile30A sleeps 10 and is perfect for two families! The house has 3 bedrooms all with their own private en-suite bathroom.

Beach & Bath towels, linens and a kitchen starter pack are also provided. Pack n’ Play and high chair are available.

Easy access to the owners locker for all guest to use include:

Six beach chairs and a beach ice chest.
5 adult bikes- many child bikes and a Burley Bike Trailer for the little ones.
Various Beach toys and floats

Wanderawhile30A's open floor plan and use of space makes this house perfect for your next vacation getaway to the beautiful Emerald Coast.

The large custom-built dining room table seats 6 , the extended kitchen island seats 6, and the outdoor dining screen porch seats 5 which provides room for everyone to spread out during meals..

Other amenities include fully equipped kitchen, including a Keurig coffee maker, flat screen tv’s in every bedroom, washer/dryer, board games, cards, WIFI, two parking spaces, an outdoor hand shower and curbside trash pick-up twice a week.

House Rules: Absolutely no smoking allowed on the property at any time . As much as we love pets, they are unfortunately not allowed on the property. An adult 25 years old or older must be staying on property with all guests during the full duration of the rental period. The property sleeps 10, parties larger than 10 (excluding newborns/infants) cannot be accommodated.

Please read the VRBO reviews to see previous guest comments to ensure you are booking the best property for the $$.

Thanks so much!
Greg & Norma
Owners

reviews.text: This house was incredible! The location is perfect for easy access to Seacrest Beach, Alys, Rosemary and Inlet. It’s a short drive to great dining and a beautiful, nice and not packed Publix! The house was the best stocked place we’ve ever stayed in! They literally had EVERYTHING for us and our 4 boys! 2 Burleys, 6 bikes, beach chairs, beach toys, pack n play, a fully stocked kitchen with quality dishes, pots, pans, cutting boards, toaster, blender, crock pot, etc.! The pool is close by (though we regretfully didn’t get to use it because it was cold). We felt so safe being in a gated community and the newly added beach tram service was icing on the cake! You won’t regret booking this place! The best deal in 30A and the owners are awesome! They are communicative, care about their guests and went above and beyond to make our trip so enjoyable and easy! We will be back! Thanks Greg & Norma!
